# Client-identifier SHAPES for scripts/check_client_identifiers.py (CI, diff only).
#
# GENERIC PATTERNS ONLY. This file is tracked, so it must never name the client,
# its company, facility or project, or any real document number - a list that
# names what it blocks publishes the list. Real names go in the git-ignored
# .githooks/client-identifiers.local, which the checker ALSO reads when present
# (a developer's machine); CI has only the shapes below.
#
# One extended regex per line (Python `re`, case-sensitive). Blank lines and
# lines starting with `#` are ignored.
#
#   allow:<regex>   a matched token that FULLY matches <regex> is a documented
#                   made-up fixture, not a client identifier.
#
# A line may also carry the marker `client-id-scan: synthetic` to say every
# token on it is made up. Use it sparingly; a reviewer should be able to see why.

# Equipment tag: unit - type code - number, optional train suffix (NN-X-NNNN[A]).
\b[0-9]{2,4}-[A-Z]{1,3}-[0-9]{3,5}[A-Z]?\b
# Project document number: prefix - unit/area - discipline - sequence.
\b[A-Z0-9]{3,8}-[0-9]{4}-[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]{4}\b
# Datasheet number: prefix - DAS - discipline letter - sheet.
\b[A-Z0-9]{2,8}-DAS-[A-Z]-[0-9]{2}\b

# Made-up fixture conventions already in use (see .githooks/pre-commit 2b).
allow:.*\b(0000|0001|1234|9999)\b.*
allow:(EX|SYN|ABC|SITE|DS)-.*
